notes: with official quick estimate, scored separately. Pure-count mx2024 remains the headline version.

Race: Sheinbaum's share of the Sheinbaum + Gálvez votes (two-way); she wins this market's event when it exceeds 50% (Máynez, third, could not win). Final = official cómputos (INE): 68.52% two-way (59.76% of all votes cast).
counted = the model's share of the expected two-way votes already counted (timeline); map f = share of the district's expected actas (polling-station tally sheets) counted.

Count path rebuilt from each acta's PREP verification time: an acta is shown from the first 5-minute PREP cut that held it, 5 minutes after the cut's label (checked against archived cut files: docs/mexico.md). PREP opened at 20:00 central time (02:00 UTC) and stopped at 93.2% of actas; the rest entered only the official cómputo days later.

Model: brunder.nowcast on 70,537 electoral sections (state = region), prior = 2018 cómputos by section (López Obrador vs Anaya + Meade), tau = 0.01. From 05:50 UTC, the count projection is inverse-variance combined with the official INE Conteo Rápido two-way interval (67.09-69.53%); rule fixed before replay in docs/fast_signals.md. Evidence: retrospective sensitivity chosen after the 2024 result was known; pure-count v1 remains the headline; this version adds the official INE quick estimate and is scored separately. The map shows the pure count's section projections summed to the 300 federal districts.
Polymarket was already >= 0.9 on Sheinbaum from 2024-06-01 00:05 UTC, two days before the count; the markets closed at 12:46-12:56 UTC on 3 June (Gamma closedTime), so pm is empty after that.

Accuracy: projected share minus final at 1/5/10/25/50% counted: 1% +1.9 (raw -0.3), 5% +0.4 (raw -1.6), 10% -0.6 (raw -2.5), 25% -1.5 (raw -2.9), 50% -1.0 (raw -2.2) points. The 90% intervals held the final share in 11% of minutes (1-95% counted): far too narrow.

After the 05:50 UTC release, mean absolute projection error was 0.655 points with the quick estimate versus 0.795 for pure-count v1. Full 1-95% coverage was 10.7% versus 10.3%; both were still far too narrow. Neither included market was contested at 90% when the count opened, so no lead is claimed.
Profit: the frozen Brazil rule (favoured side, edge >= 5c after costs, >= 1% counted) found no signal in either market, so there is nothing to fill.
pm = Polymarket price of the YES (= Sheinbaum) side, carried forward minute by minute. No Kalshi data.
